steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: set-wall-structures
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const walls = s.floorPlan.walls; let ext = 0, brick = 0, dry = 0; for (const w of walls) { if (w.thickness === 'external') { s.updateWall(w.id, { structure: 'load-bearing' }, 'ground'); ext++; } else if (brick < 2) { s.updateWall(w.id, { structure: 'brick-partition' }, 'ground'); brick++; } else if (dry < 2) { s.updateWall(w.id, { structure: 'drywall' }, 'ground'); dry++; } } window.__wallCounts = { ext, brick, dry }; })()

steps.name: toggle-hackability
steps.eval: (() => { window.__hackDone = false; const findView = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup="menu"]')].find((b) => /^\s*View/.test(b.textContent || '')); const findHack = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => (b.textContent || '').trim() === 'Hackability'); (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { let h = findHack(); if (!h) { findView()?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); h = findHack(); } if (h) { h.click(); window.__hackDone = true; return; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } })(); })()
